text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Fan Fest is here. The<n>instant Shinko
Windy's event ends,<n>she comes right up to me and
says...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I'mma crash the next big<n>event!
choice_data_list: As in, join at the last second?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I've got nothing left on my schedule,<n>so I'm
fiending for some<n>entertainment!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
One event's not enough for me, let<n>alone my fans!
They need to see<n>MORE Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, let's go find a good one<n>while we check
out the food stalls!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Lemme see... Lemme see...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, pretty much all of 'em are<n>drawing a good
crowd. I think I'd do<n>best iiin—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mgh?! What's that crowd for?

text_block_list.name: Pearl and King
text_block_list.text: Ohohohoho! Hohohoho! Ohohoho!<n>Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe! ♪ I see the two of you are<n>really fired up.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: However, I will be the victor oftoday's carrot-eating race.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
A carrot-eating race?! Is that like a<n>bread-eating
race, but with carrots?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: This is it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The stands are packed and<n>chomping's my middle
name!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Make way for Windy! I'm here<n>to take the
win!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait—Windy?! You can't just barge in<n>on other
people's contests!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In front of us is King Halo, a prim and<n>proper
Umamusume who wears<n>"first-rate" as a badge of
honor. Her<n>pride may be through the roof, but<n>she
has the skills to back it up.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha! Here comes a new<n>challenger! C'mon
and lemme in on<n>the fun!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh! A last minute entry? I see no<n>reason to protest.
Welcome,<n>welcome!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And this is Seeking the Pearl. She's a<n>well-traveled
Umamusume with a<n>fabulous flair. The world is her
oyster!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind, either. There are plenty<n>of carrots to
go around, and, as today<n>is a festival, it would be in
bad taste<n>to turn you away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The last to comment is Grass<n>Wonder, a racer who
pursues<n>Japanese ideals of beauty with such
conviction, you'd never believe she<n>was born in
America.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Grass... Well, you may have a point.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Very well, I grant you the right to join<n>us! A
last-minute entry is no problem<n>for a first-rate
Umamusume like<n>myself. I will win with class
regardless!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Prepare to get trounced, then!<n>I've got a
secret plan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then... the carrot-eating race<n>begins! The
Umamusume burst out of<n>the gate in unison.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hrrraaagh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy swiftly takes the lead!<n>Could she be
testing out front running<n>today?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh! I'mma eat all the<n>carrots so those
suckers won't know<n>what to do!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wheeze! Huff! Carrots... Mmmm,carrots...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Urgh! I think I... got ahead ofmyself.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: But I can't keel over now!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! Here I—mngh!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: HRK?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My word! Chomping on so many so<n>fast is only
going to—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Just bend down already! I'll hit your<n>back for you!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Windy! First, calm down! Now...<n>cough! One
more time!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dear! Wait, she got it out? Thank<n>goodness,
she's going to be all right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to everyone's help, Shinko<n>Windy
manages to get back on her<n>feet. She tries to make
up for lost<n>time, but...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I came second to last...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This isn't the result she was looking<n>for, but the
incident got some<n>coverage, so I guess she
managed to<n>stand out, in a way.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy is bringing up the rear!<n>But she
seems to be holding back. Is<n>this part of her plan?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (Heh heh heh! No reason to rush it.)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(What this race really comes down to<n>is chomping
power!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! The carrots are fresh! I didn't<n>expect them to
be this solid!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: The nerve of these things! I can't<n>even catch one!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The string it's tied to just keeps<n>spinning around
and around. How am<n>I supposed to bite it?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hop, hop, hop!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The athletes are having a tough time!<n>Carrots don't
break apart like bread<n>does!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yes... Just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I've bitten everything under the sun,<n>so I could see
this coming from a mile<n>away!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
First, I have to find the easiest target<n>and choose
the best angle to jump<n>at... Got one!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Chomp!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Number Two, Shinko Windy, has<n>nabbed her own
carrot in a single<n>attempt! Now she makes a dash
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Crunch, crunch! GULP!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Catch ya later, chumps!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Shinko Windy! The last-second<n>challenger wins
first place!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mwahahaha! MWAHAHAHA! Just<n>another day for
Wicked Windy!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Wow! Congrats! That was fun<n>to watch!
That was the cutest little<n>chomp I've ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heheee! ♪ Everyone's eyes are<n>fixed on me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm the star of today's event! Me!<n>Me! Me!
